title: restore_optimistic ends in `_ => {}` and apply_error lists the same variants again; ChatPermissions, ChatPinOrder and ArchiveChatListSettings are handled in a second place
trigger: Add a new RequestRollback variant
effect: The compiler does not force a rollback arm, so a refused change can stay on screen
fix: One exhaustive match (move the three arms into restore_optimistic) and delete the wildcard

title: SavedPage { Idle, Asking(RequestId) } sits beside TopicHistory::older/OlderEnd, the real paging stage of the same history
trigger: Open a Saved sublist, scroll to load an older page, the page fails
effect: Page-in-flight lives in `page` while Failed/Complete live in `history.older`; they are reset separately (session_saved.rs:198-260) and can disagree
fix: Put the request into the older end (OlderEnd::Asking(RequestId)) and delete SavedPage

title: ChatSearchState keeps `chat_id: Option` beside `status == Closed` and resets sender/media/from_picker by hand in open_for and close
trigger: Open in-chat search, pick a sender and media tab, close, reopen for another chat
effect: No bug today; open/closed lives in two fields (chat_id and status) changed together in open_for/close, and the filter fields are cleared at two call sites
fix: enum ChatSearchSurface { Closed, Open(OpenChatSearch { chat_id, query, criteria, results, paging, jump }) } replaced whole on open/close

title: clear_query keeps `confirm` (PaidPostSearch) while the results and generation reset
trigger: Free public-post searches run out, the Stars confirm row shows for query X, the user clears the field
effect: The inline confirm row for the old query can stay over the Recents surface (accepting is guarded by query, so it only misleads)
fix: Fold `confirm` into the search stage (or reset it in clear_results) so a new generation drops it

title: PendingBotMessage keeps `can_stop: bool` beside `stop: BotStopStage` and finish_pending_bot_stop sets both by hand
trigger: Stop a bot's streaming draft that has keep_on_stop
effect: No bug today; Stopped implies can_stop=false is written in one place (session_apply_messages.rs:585)
fix: Make BotStopStage carry can-stop (Running { can_stop }, Stopped) so one value changes

title: Venue bot lookup answered by purpose only; VenueBot::Resolving holds no RequestId
trigger: Change the venue bot username (set_venue_bot_username resets to Unknown) while a ResolveVenueBot request is in flight
effect: The old username's answer lands as Found/Missing for the new username
fix: VenueBot::Resolving(RequestId); venue_bot_resolved takes the pending id and ignores any other

title: baseline: SettingsState::pending_attention (bool, one-shot dock bounce)
trigger: A notifying message arrives with flash_bounce on
effect: No bug: drain_on_screen takes it. Listed in the baseline and allow list
fix: Fold into the notification drain (NotifyDrain event queued with the notification) so no bool is kept

title: Inline query answer is matched by (chat, bot, first_page) against `InlineQueryFetch::Loading`, not by the RequestId
trigger: Type `@bot cat`, then change to `@bot dog` while the first request is out (inline_query returns Ok(None) while one is in flight, so the slot keeps query `cat`)
effect: The cat page lands in the slot as the answer to the current query, or the dog query is never sent until the next keystroke
fix: InlineQueryFetch::Loading(RequestId) and accept only the answer whose id is held; re-send when the typed query differs from the slot's

title: A late voters page becomes the whole list after updatePoll dropped the cached pages
trigger: Open the voters dialog, press Load more, an updatePoll arrives (apply_update_poll retains the cached pages away), then the page answers
effect: offset>0 with no Loaded entry falls through to `_ => voters`: the dialog shows only voters 51-100 as the full list with a wrong total
fix: PollVotersFetch::Loading(RequestId) / Paging(RequestId); drop an answer whose id is not the one held

title: baseline: ActiveGroupCall::loaded_all_participants (TDLib mirror)
trigger: Join a group call with many participants
effect: No bug: mirrors groupCall.loaded_all_participants; allow-listed as independent
fix: Keep as is, or ParticipantsLoad::{Partial, All} when touched

title: apply_local_search_filter writes surface and generation by hand, bypassing begin_query/bump_generation
trigger: Screenshot demo or offline path types in global search with a debounced query pending
effect: The typed Debounce stays armed and confirm/top_view are not reset, because only SearchState's own transitions cancel them
fix: Call begin_query/begin_recents and then accept_* so the stage resets in its own transitions

title: MentionSearch::request and FromPicker::request are `Option<RequestId>` meaning in flight, with the results beside them
trigger: Type `@` in a group, then a refused or lost searchChatMembers
effect: No bug today (fail_mention_search and the search error path clear them); loading and loaded-empty differ only by an Option
fix: Fetch-like enum { Asking(RequestId), Ready(Vec<..>), Failed } per search

title: forget_screen_outcomes does not clear users_state.contacts_notice
trigger: Import or delete contacts in an account, switch away before the answer, switch back
effect: The account comes back showing an old 'Contacts imported.' / 'Contact deleted.' line as news
fix: Drain contacts_notice through the same one-shot list, or key it to the screen that asked

title: Ping slot is PingStatus::Checking in proxy.pings plus the RequestId in settings.proxy_ping_requests, kept in step by hand
trigger: Ping a proxy, edit it (slot cleared) and ping again
effect: No bug today; take_awaited_ping has to check both maps and every writer has to update both
fix: PingStatus::Checking(RequestId) and delete proxy_ping_requests

title: One `proxy.error: Option<String>` beside three stages (fetch, mutation, IPv6 save) and the system step
trigger: Load of the proxy list fails, then an unrelated background fetch succeeds
effect: The load error stays until a mutation succeeds or the user refreshes; each stage clears the line only in some paths
fix: Put the error in each stage (ProxyFetch::Failed(String), ProxyMutation::Failed(String)) and derive the line

title: ReplyTarget::Retry never gives up: any error other than 400/404 (403, 500) is asked again every 10 seconds
trigger: Open a chat with a reply to a message TDLib answers with 403 (no access)
effect: getRepliedMessage is re-sent from upkeep every 10 s for as long as the chat is shown
fix: ReplyTarget::Retry { until, attempts } with a cap, then Missing

title: recent_inline_bots: Option is the 'fetched' flag, with no Failed or Loading stage
trigger: Type '@' in a composer while getRecentInlineBots fails
effect: None means both 'never asked' and 'failed'; the in-flight check is a scan of pending by purpose (connect/bots.rs maybe_fetch_recent_inline_bots); the error is not recorded, so each '@' re-asks
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> with the request in Loading

title: SavedPage { Idle, Asking(RequestId) } sits beside TopicHistory's own older-end stage for the same page
trigger: Page a Saved Messages sublist or tag filter and fail a page
effect: Failure sets page = Idle and history.fail_older() by hand in three places (fail_saved_tag_page, fail_saved_topic_page, awaiting_saved_tag_search); two values for one stage
fix: Take the request from the history's older-end stage (OlderEnd::Asking(RequestId)) and drop SavedPage

title: date_jump_pending (Option tuple) and chat_search.jump (Loading{message_id}) must change together and are cleared by hand in five places
trigger: Start a date jump, then pick a search hit, or delete the message the jump waits for (miss_search_jump sets Missing but not date_jump_pending)
effect: The pending date jump outlives its jump; a later load-around of the same message id resolves with the old mode and retargets the view
fix: Put the mode in ChatSearchJump::Loading { message_id, then: DateJumpMode }

title: send_as_options Fetch::Loading { request: None }: the stage never holds the request, and the answer inserts Ready by chat id
trigger: Open the send-as picker in a chat, close it and reopen (or an update races the answer)
effect: Answer (domains/messages/apply.rs:44) and error (error.rs:133) are matched by purpose + chat id, one-in-flight guarded only by a pending scan; a Retry answer of an older request is taken as current
fix: Store the RequestId in Loading and use Fetch::answered(request, ..) for the answer and error

title: begin_sponsored_hide resets sponsored_report to Idle by hand, dropping a report flow in flight (Asking or Picking)
trigger: Start reporting ad A (picker open or request out), then choose Hide ads on ad B
effect: The report picker/flow of A vanishes without Cancel or an answer; accept_sponsored_hidden was fixed to keep it (13-034) but this reset still overwrites it
fix: Only reset from the flow's own transitions: leave Asking/Picking alone as accept_sponsored_hidden does

title: Batch progress is four hand-kept fields (batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed, batch_pending) plus the requests in flight
trigger: Batch install/archive several sets, switch account or lose a request without an answer
effect: batch_pending only shrinks on an answer or send failure; a dropped request leaves the batch counted as pending and the totals never settle
fix: One BatchStage { Idle, Running { pending: Vec<(set, RequestId)>, done, failed } }

title: archived/trending paging reads archived_offset/trending_offset written at send time, not the offset the answered request carried
trigger: Page archived or trending sets, a refetch (updateTrendingStickerSets) is sent while the earlier page is out
effect: accept_* decides replace-or-append from the offset of the latest send, so an answer can replace or append to the wrong page; single-flight (has_purpose) is the only guard
fix: Carry the offset in the request (RequestPurpose) or a Fetch Loading { request, offset }

title: fail_story_report_send replaces the whole report flow, also one that belongs to another story
trigger: Report story A (Checking), switch to story B and a send of B fails
effect: A's flow is overwritten by B's Failed; A's answer is then dropped as unmatched
fix: Fail only when the current flow is for chat_id/story_id; otherwise ignore

title: baseline: RowForum::loaded
fix: Derive from a topics Fetch (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of contains_key || forum_topics_failed

title: leave_open_chat closes the thread only when thread.chat_id == prev, not when thread.origin_chat_id == prev
trigger: Open a channel post's comments (status SwitchingChat, thread.chat_id = discussion group, open chat still the channel), then move the channel to its own window
effect: The main window's thread survives with open = None and later runs switch_to_thread_chat, opening the discussion group in the main window the user just emptied
fix: Close the thread when either its chat or its origin is the chat left (one OwnedBy check)

title: A calendar jump on a searched tab sends the plain list but keeps the query
trigger: Type a query in Files, Music or Links, open the calendar and pick a day: jump_shared_media_to_day sends searchChatMessages with query "" while the tab keeps query, and later pages use shared_media_query
effect: The first page is unfiltered and older pages are filtered by the query, so the list mixes two result sets under the search box text
fix: begin_fetch_at_day clears the query (or the jump sends it); query and anchor are one 'what the list answers' value
